machine_type.description: The QEMU machine type to emulate (e.g., virt, raspi2, imx7).

machine_accel.description: The accelerator to use for the machine (e.g., tcg, kvm).

smp_cpus.description: Number of CPUs initially present on the machine.

smp_maxcpus.description: Maximum number of CPUs that can be added at runtime.

disk_image_path.description: Path to the disk image file (e.g., .qcow2, .img).

disk_interface.description: The interface type for the disk drive (e.g., sd, virtio, ide, none).

disk_cache.description: Cache mode for the disk (e.g., writethrough, writeback, none, unsafe).

disk_media.description: Media type of the drive (e.g., disk, cdrom).

boot_order.description: Boot order drive letters (e.g., d for CD-ROM, n for network).

initrd_path.description: Path to the initial RAM disk image.

display_type.description: Type of display to use (e.g., gtk, sdl, vnc, none, egl-headless).

display_params.description: Additional parameters for the display type (e.g., for vnc: addr=0.0.0.0,port=5900).

no_graphic.description: Disable graphical output and redirect serial ports to console (nographic).

cpu_model.description: CPU model to emulate (e.g., cortex-a15, arm1176).

network_backends.description: List of network backend configurations (netdevs). Each item is a map with keys: type, id, and options (map of key-value pairs for netdev-specific options). Supported types: user, tap, bridge, socket, etc.

nics.description: List of network device configurations (NICs). Each item is a map with keys: driver, netdev_id, mac_address. Supported drivers: virtio-net-pci, rtl8139, smc91c111, etc.

serial_config.description: Serial port redirection device (e.g., stdio, vc, none, pty).

guest_name.description: Name of the guest displayed in the window caption.

system_uuid.description: System UUID. Empty string means no UUID is set.

enable_semihosting.description: Enable semihosting support (ARM, M68K, Xtensa, MIPS, RISC-V).

dtb_path.description: Path to the device tree binary (dtb) file. Empty string means no DTB is passed.
